name: intro
prompt: A warm, cheerful old Indian farmer holds a small clay bowl of groundnut seeds and talks to the camera. He glances down at the prepared soil, then back at the camera with a smile, ready to plant. He keeps holding the bowl and his walking stick. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement, slow and small gestures.

name: patience
prompt: A wise, kind old Indian farmer talks to the camera like a grandfather giving advice. He slowly raises his free hand to chest height with one finger pointing up, as if sharing an important lesson, shaking his head gently with a knowing smile. His other hand keeps holding his walking stick. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement, slow and small gestures.
